column15:
I certify that the work I will be selling is my own original work, and not AI generated, drop-shipped, or stolen. If you are using a pattern created by someone else, please provide a link with proof in the additional comments that shows you have received explicit permission to use the pattern for commercial purposes. 

If found to be false, a ban from all future events will be issued.

(Note: 3rd party manufacturing is permitted as long as it is still your original design/artwork)

column19:

Vendors can booth for up to 2 days, but you may select all days you are available.

NOTE: 
- Your booth must be active for at least 5 hours during each market day. Please arrange to have someone take over in the case that you need to leave your booth during the event.
- You will be given the highest tier available among the selections made.
- If no selected tiers are available on a given day, you may not be assigned a table. [Monday, March 17th]

Do you want to have a half table or full table?

NOTE:
- Half tables will cost 50% of the price of a full table.
- You may have to share a table with a stranger.
- Full tables have less availability; choosing "Either" increases your chances of being selected if spots become limited.
column25:
If you chose half table, do you have anyone you would like to share a full table with?

Please enter the exact email address they submitted on their application here.

NOTE:
- They must submit their own separate application.
- We will do our best to put you together, but we do not guarantee that you will share a table.
- The email entered must match our records. Please confirm with your desired table mate.
- You must be attending on the same days in the same table tiers in order to share a table.
